body: With the core gaps closed, the owner chose to build all remaining areas: organizations, teams, roles, permissions and access control (org checklist); SSO (OIDC and SAML), SCIM, device authorization, OAuth proxy and popup; and acting as an OAuth/OIDC provider (oauth-provider, MCP, CIMD, agent auth). Each ships as its own module (module rule), opt-in, matching shape. This reverses the 2026-10-02 out-of-scope decision.
title: Owner 2026-10-07: organizations/roles, enterprise sign-in and OAuth provider are now in scope
